puzzle.hint: A verse describing the best form of speech and conduct: calling to Allah, doing good deeds, and affirming one's submission to Him.
puzzle.arabic: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًۭا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
